scope: Stage 0 diagnostic ground reconstruction and isolated hardware reference; no production terrain acceptance

groundEstimate.method: Mapped open areas; 16 m buildings / 4 m vegetation / 2 m other exclusions; source quality; 3x3 DSM range<=2m; 10m blocks with >=3 samples, observed value nearest p20; Huber curvature-regularized 10m lattice; bilinear diagnostic output at 2m

spatialHoldout.interpretation: Agreement with held-out candidate DSM observations only; not ground truth or geodetic accuracy

route.interpretation: Diagnostic profile, not a validated walkable route

limitations: Contemporary authored masks are not a complete historical inventory of roofs and vegetation
Wide elevated objects can survive candidate selection
Interpolated areas and extrapolation at edges remain uncertain
Variant spread is not a confidence interval
Smoothing controls slopes; these are candidate slopes, not proven real slopes

alignment.purpose: Relative alignment diagnostic only; no surveyed control, no automatic correction
alignment.sourceSamplingOffsetMeaning: DSM is sampled at model X+dx,Z+dz. A positive result is a diagnostic optimum, not an authorized georeference change.
alignment.method: Current simple footprint geometries only; compound recipes with sections excluded because top-level outlines are not authoritative body geometry. Buildings>=6m high and >=200m2, edges>=8m; samples 4m inside/outside every4m, away from vertices/map boundary. Per building mean clipped contrast [-10,20]; aggregate median across buildings. Translation search +/-20m step2m.

vertical_conversion.formula: h_ellipsoid = H_EGM2008 + N; H_EGM2008 = h_ellipsoid - N
vertical_conversion.pipeline: proj=pipeline step proj=unitconvert xy_in=deg xy_out=rad step proj=vgridshift grids=/Users/ilia-may/Documents/local-repo/syktyvkar-underground/output/ring-terrain-stage0/egm08-geoid-check-crop.tif multiplier=1 step proj=unitconvert xy_in=rad xy_out=deg
vertical_conversion.note: Bilinear interpolation of the official 2.5 arcminute EGM2008 geoid grid; datum conversion, not ground-truth validation.

coarseComparison.method: Native GEDTM3857 pixel centers whose complete footprints lie inside world. Candidate ellipsoid heights averaged over 9x9 midpoint subpixels in each native GEDTM pixel. GEDTM EGM2008 converted with official PROJ EGM2008 geoid at center. Native GEDTM pixel ~76.66 projected m, about36.4ground m here.
coarseComparison.bias_sign: candidate ellipsoid height minus GEDTM ellipsoid height
coarseComparison.dependencies: Not fully independent: ArcticDEM mosaics aligned to Copernicus, GEDTM inputs include Copernicus. Comparison detects coarse inconsistency; validates neither ground truth nor geodetic accuracy.

coarseComparison.road_support_definition: Native GEDTM cells containing >=1 diagnostic anchor whose coordinate falls inside current road polygons; cells counted once. Anchors are candidates, not proven ground.

hardwareBaseline.scope: Real WorldView, CellStreamer and browser Havok over the current exported static layout. Stationary local neutral controller, no visible avatars or items, no room/network/database. Camera route is not a verified walking route. Not full city gameplay acceptance.

gatePostprocessing.method: Recomputed nearest-rank p95 gates from the same recorded raw frame arrays; no new benchmark run

hardwareBaseline.measurementMode: headless Chromium with hardware Metal; render-loop intervals, not physical display presentation
